tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i lag len gsal bar bshad pa ma nor don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza bai ro tsa na ye/ dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med rnam snang chen por gus btud nas/ /kun rig dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas bsnyen pa las rung bya tshul dang / /de yi sbyin sreg cho ga'i lag len rnams/ /'khrul zad bla ma'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin/ /ma nor don tshang gsal bar bshad pa'i ngag /don gnyer blo yi re ba bskong phyir spel/ /de la 'dir rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nang tshan ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi sgo nas bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pas/ rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba/ chos gsungs pa/ ras bris kyi lha bzhengs pa sogs ma byung gi bar dang / 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug tu sgom bzlas kyi dus bzla ba dang / tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum mam drug bzla te gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma yin la/ de la yang dpa' bo gcig pa dang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / ras bris la brten pa gsum las/ 'dir snga ma la yang spyi khyab tu 'jug par byed pa/ rdor sems bsgoms nas rtsa rig bzla ba dang / dkyil 'khor rang rang gi gtso bo bsgoms nas rang sngags bzla ba gnyis las/ 'dir dang po ltar 'chad par byed pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ gnas dben par kun rig gi bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun du/ chu gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / rang gi gdan nang tshangs can bshams pa'i mdun shar la sogs par bstan pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang / logs gcig tu cha gsum gtor ma dang bcas mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sha chang sogs spangs ba'i gtsang sbra dang khrus byas la/

mtshams g.yog snga mo nas dmigs nges pa gnyis gsum sogs byed dgos pa yin zhing / mi gsar pa sogs ci thod thod byas pas mi chog pas/ mtshams byas pa'i dgos pa med pa yin zhing / tha mal pa'i gtam mi smra ba ngag bcad la/ de nas thun gsum mam bzhi gang rigs las/ 'dir ni 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir thun gsum pa phyag len la mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ srod tho rangs gang rung thun gsum du bcad nas/ thun mgo srod thun la byas nas/ thor thun la grol bar mdzad/ yang thun bzhir byed tshe/ dgong / srod tho rangs/ snga thun dang bzhi las/ thun mgo dgong thun nas 'dzin zhing / snga thun la grol bar mdzad do/ /'dir ni snga ma ltar/ srod kyi dus su/ rang nyid gdan la 'khod nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bsang / oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pas rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas sbyangs la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba ddharmāḥswa bhā wa shud ddho haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ nas/ shapta hūm̐/ sogs so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs dril bu bsil zhing / dharma ra ṇi ta/ sogs tshar gsum brjod do/ /de nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞

'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes nyer gcig sogs dang / de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam du rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya snying khar bcas te lan gsum du sems bskyed de/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba ddharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho haṃ gis chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon/ zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ de'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur par bsam la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/

mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas pa gnas gsum du reg cing / oṃ badzra sa twa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badzra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a bhā ya/ nā shā ya/ nā shā ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra nān hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung ba/ yang lan gsum brjod la/ dang pos 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / gnyis pas phyogs rdo rje'i ra ba me ris dang bcas pa/ gsum pas de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur bsam pa ste gnas bsrung ba/ yang lan gsum brjod pas rnal 'byor bsrung bar bsams te bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /bdag bskyed dngos la gsum/ lha 'grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ ched du gtang ba'i bzlas pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lag pa gnyis mdun du gshibs la/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang aḥbasam/ thal mo gnyis la/ a āḥ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis brjod pa'i rjes su/ rnams kyis gang ba las 'od zer 'phros/ g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la trām̐/ srin lag la hrī/ mthe'u chung la āḥbakod/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin 'byung / srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar gyur par bsams la/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / oṃ a n+yo a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥlha dang lha mo rnams reg rdo rje thal mo dang / spha ra spha ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥbadzra añdza li/ yis rjes su zhugs/ rdo rje bsdam pa dang / a dyanta a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra ban dha/

yis gcig tu 'dres par bsams zhing / sems 'od gsal bar bsams la/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum dkrol zhing / se gol gtog la/ badzra ban dha tra ḍa/ kyis sdig pa thams cad dral/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug la/ oṃ badzra a be sha zhes dang / aḥ bcu nas brgya'i bar bzlas nas/ snying khar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin du dbab cing / tiṣṭha badzra ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣṭha sarba siddhi me pra yañtsa hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes brjod cing phyag rgya dkrol/ yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing / badzra muṣṭi zhes brjod/ oṃ badzra muṣṭi baṃ/ lan gsum gyis phyag rgya dkrol zhing se gol gtogs te/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhoḥsarba ddharmāḥswa bhā wa shud dho ham̐/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsams te/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bhri ta bhri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ kyis sku dang / thal mo snyim pa sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ kyis gsung dang / rdo rje thal mo las gung mo gnyis dang mtha' bzhi sbyar te brkyangs pa snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ tstshin da tstshin da sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭ kyis thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gung mo gnyis rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs/

mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis brkyang ba phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nyid las/ mdzub mo dang srin lag padma 'dra bar byas pa sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de nyid las/ mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ mthe bong dang mthe chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyangs pa sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥde nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ kārma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥzhes brjod cing gnas de rnams su/ mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas/ spyir sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu ngan song gsum la phog pas 'gro ba de dag gi sdig pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam la/ tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang / sdud pa mang po'i 'phreng ba/ nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/

lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas/ mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod/ /ces ched du brjod nas/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra titstsha pū dzā me gha sa mu tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyi mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shapta dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar bzhag pa g.yas su bskor zhing / sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar la/ /rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ /rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ /mchod pa chen po rgya mtsho che/ /rdo rje padma byang chub che/ /byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen te/ /rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin tshe/ /rdo rje padma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed/ /rdo rje ro langs ro langs byed/ /rdo rje srin po za ba po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gdon de gdon gyi mchog /'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa/

/bsgrub dka'i bsgrub pa legs pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyes mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ /'od stug pas ni sdug pa che/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che/ /rigs sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ha la ha la nag po che/ /dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can/ /rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba/ /skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod/ /glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ /rdo rje me ste ma rung 'dul/ /drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa/ /nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ /khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ /phyag rnams du mar mtshon cha brgya/ /du ma'i zhal te sku yang stong / /'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyil ba ste/ /sems ni chos pas sku mi mnga'/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar byed/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba/ /zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /rdo rje rab dgyes rdo rje sems/ /kun tu bzang po cher bzang po/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rnam brgyan pa/ /khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang / /zhes sogs brjod pas bstod la/ de nas/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ na mo/ sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod la/ de las 'od 'phros ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid la thim par gyur/ ces bsam zhing /

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te saṃ myaka saṃ bud dhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swāhā/ zhes pa'i rtsa rig stong phrag gsum bzhi lnga la sogs pa gang thon bzlas te/ thun 'jog pa dang / snying khar thal mo sbyar nas/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas/ sgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam la/ slar yang bdag nyid la mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar la/ spro na/ 'jig rten khams 'dir dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra titstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams gong rjes la/ me tog dang puṣpe/ bdug spos dang / dhu pe/ snang gsal dang / ā lo ke dri mchog dang / gandhe/ zhal zas dang / nai wi tya/ rol mo dang / shabta/ rnams kyis mchod la/ dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ sogs brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyag chen lnga dang bcas la/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang / /gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod bstod bsdus pa la spro na/ sngags mchod tsam dang / rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma rnams chus sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra yakṣas bsang ba nas/ an dha ka ra ye swāhā/

zhes pa'i bar rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyi cho ga sbyin sreg gi skabs ltar bsam/ gzhi bdag dang / rigs drug yi dwags gsum gyi gtor ma 'dir mi dgos/ gas btang / bgegs gtor phyir dor/ dus rgyun du gung thun rjes dang / grol ba'i nyin mor thor thun rjes su cha gsum gtong zhing / yang thun gzhir byed tshe/ tshugs pa'i dgongs dus su rgyun du dgong thun rjes dang / grol ba'i nyin snga thun la grol bas de'i rjes su cha gsum btang ngo / /gsum pa rjes ni/ bdag bskyed ltar rang nyid la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sogs/ sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur/ oṃ bhri ta sogs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badzra sa twa kro dha sogs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas lan gsum snying khar bcas pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor pa sogs pa'i bar chad bsrung / de nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /gis dge ba bsngo/ /de nas dril bu bsil zhing / ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba'i/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral༞ chos la༞ sems can gang dag༞ de dag thams cad༞ tshogs kyi dam pa༞ dge 'dun༞ sems can gang༞ de dag thams cad༞ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon gsum gyis deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces pa'i bar stan thog gcig tu byed dgos pa yin/ gang thod thod du byas pas mi chog pas/ de bzhin shes par bya ba dang / thun mtshams rnams su/ chag med byed dgos rnams dang / dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' ba dang / spyod lam sogs ci bder 'jug pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas/ bsnyen pa'i grangs rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum mam/

drug bzla dgos te/ rgyud las/ 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar 'dod na zla ba gsum dang / drug bzla bar 'dod na zla ba drug bya'o/ /de la sngags tsam gyi kha skong tshe rtsa rig khri tsho gsum mam drug bzla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis rang rang gi bsnyen pa byed na yang snga mas rigs 'gre sbyar nas shes par bya dgos pa yin la/ spyi don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bsnyen rgyas ltar bya zhing / gsum pa ras bris bsnyen pa ni/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ gsang sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing kha skong ba dang / rang gi sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na gang du bya ba'i gnas su/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin btang la/ dang po gnyis kyis 'phrin las 'chol ba'i rjes su/ sa phyogs 'dir 'phags pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la bstsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de gshegs gsol sogs bya/ bgegs gtor rjes su/ sa'i phyogs 'dir/ sogs gong ltar las/ 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar/ 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang / khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yung dkar gyis phyogs kun tu brab pas bgegs thams cad byer bar bsam pa ni sa bslang ba'o/

/de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs thams cad lag pas bcags la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas thabs kyi gzhi 'thas par byas la/ der thig chen brgyad btab ste/ zlum bskor dgu byas pa'i/ dang po dbus nas sor brgyad bskor ba'i 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po la dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du gtso bo/ phyogs mtshams su rigs bzhi yum bzhi/ de'i phyi rol tu sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan ma rnams bris/ de nas sor bzhi pa gsum bskor ba'i dang po la/ rtsibs brgyad byas te phyogs bzhir sgo ba bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mtshan ma bris/ gnyis pa gzhi ser po la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba/ gsum pa gzhi dkar po la rdo rje rgya gram ljang khu/ de nas sor gnyis pa gnyis bskor ba'i dang po gzhi ljang khu la rin po che ser po/ gnyis pa gzhi ser po la padma dmar po/ slar yang ji ltar 'tshams pa'i zlum bskor gsum bskor ba'i dang po gnyis phyogs mdog tu byas pa'i nang ma la skal bzang / phyi ma la nyan rang dang / phyogs bzhir phyi'i sgo ba bcu drug dang / zlum bskor phyi ma la khor yug gi lha brgya bcu gcig la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bris shing / tshon gyi kha dog gsal kha med pa rnams dkar por bya/ yang na gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la gcad rnams ci mdzes su bya zhing / lha'i gnas rnams su rdul tshon nam me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i phyi rol tu thab stegs gru bzhi la gra 'gugs bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang du bstan pa bris/ de nas nang gi rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba'i zlum bskor steng srog chags med pa'i bud shing zlum por brtsigs la/ steng du rtswa skam po dang bcas pa spor lde/

thab nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag thab kyi nub tu slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs pa'i stan bshams la/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang gzar blug gzar kha sbyar ba dang / dung chos la sogs par dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i thor yab dang bcas pa bzhag 'byor na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar po yang bshams/ rang gi g.yas phyogs nas yam shing 'o ma can mtho gang la rtsi ma nyams pa rtsa rtse mar ram sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ mar til lam yungs dkar zho zan nam mngar gsum dang ra'i 'o ma sogs sbyar ba'i zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ sran ma/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams so so'am/ yang na yam shing mar ma gtogs gzhan rnams bsres nas bshams kyang rung ste de ltar byas na bde'o/ /g.yon phyogs nas mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / phyogs skyong / 'byung po/ gzhi bdag rnams la zlum gtor re re/ rigs drug dang yi dwags la bsil gtor re re/ bgegs gtor rnams rim pas bshams/ 'byor na bla bre gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs ji ltar mdzes par bshams la/ yo byad thams cad dri bzang gi chus gtor te bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ snga dro snga bar langs la khrus byas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la rang gzhan gyi sdig pa sbyang bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ thab la kha phyogs par skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dpa' bo gcig pa bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar rdzogs par byas bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod dang / la/ sngar gyi dpal 'bar la me sbar te/ thab la g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod de me tshang gi ting lo sbar la rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas te me gso dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa kha yar bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor zhing mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang /

swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang / yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur ces brjod la mchod rdzas rnams so so'i sngags dang / bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ kyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas badzra yakṣas bsang / oṃ shas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang / rin po che dang padmas mtshan pa'i mu khyud rim pa gsum dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ agna ye mahā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sād ka ka ru ṇya kri ta sarba artha/ asmansinni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ gyis gdan phul/ thab kyi dbus su padma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis rin po che dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis padma dang spyi blug 'dzin pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas/ oṃ agna ye sā pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa re mgor sbyar ba'i argham̐ nas shabta'i bar gyis mchod te/

oṃ agna ye sarba pā paṃ da ha na shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sam/ yang na bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang mar dang sreg rdzas gzhan rnams lan gsum gsum phul la mthar rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ me lha la sreg rdzas 'bul ba 'di 'og tu bshad kyang 'dir byas na bde'o/ /de nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / spro na/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe snang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnod dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ri e hye hi sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan phul la/ me lha'i lto ba yangs par pad nyi'i gdan la 'khod ces sam/ spro na/ 'khod pa ni khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/

de nas/ ma hā kro dhā ra dza sngon du 'gro ba'i argham̐ nas/ shabta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /ma lus dbang du bsdus la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod la/ oṃ badzra sa twa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badzra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a bhā ya/ nā shā ya nā shā ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra nān hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa gsum la sogs pas bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba'i mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ sogs spel tshig dang / bcom ldan 'das khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang /

byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes brjod/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ thab kyi shar lhor pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ buddha dharma seṅgha argham̐ nas shabta'i bar gyis mchod/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa zla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ mnyes bzhin du me lha'i thugs khar zla gdan la 'khod par gyur/ de dag gi thugs kha'i 'od zer dang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bkug ste me la thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsreg par gyur/ ces brjod/ na mo ratna tra yā ya buddha dharma saṅghe bhye'i rjes su gong gi sarba pā paṃ sogs sam/ bdag gi sogs spel tshig btab pas bsreg rdzas gsum mam lnga la sogs pa phul/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slar yang thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya satwam̐/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi lto bar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ spro na bzhugs pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa argham̐ nas/ shabta'i bar gyi mchod/

rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ gis bsreg rdzas lan gsum lnga la sogs pa phul rjes spel tshig gong ltar brjod la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng dang / 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi gnas su padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyi sgo'i khro bo rnams nyi ma'i gdan/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la srog chags la sogs pa so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing /

/nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /ces dang / oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbha ga wan e hye hi mahā ka ru ṇi ka dri shya ho sa ma ya satwam̐/ zhes pas spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa la/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes dang pad bskor sngon 'gro'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swāhās mchod yon 'bul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /g.yas pas khrus gsol ba'i stengs ka byed cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rjes phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /padma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ padma ka ma la satwam̐/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus su skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ zhal bzhi dkar ba/

rtsa zhal shar du gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen sngon po/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ting 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu shākya ri dbang ser po chos 'chad gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du me tog cher rgyas ljang ku g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can dang / thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can no/ /shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo g.yas pa spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas utpal 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yon gdan la brten cing / sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing / nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar gyi gdan bzhi la/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje legs pa ljang khu rdo rje se gol gyis legs so ster ba'o/ /lho'i gdan bzhi la/ rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing g.yon dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi gdan bzhi la/ rdo rje chos dkar la cung zad dmar ba g.yon padma 'dzin cing / g.yas pa de'i kha 'byed pa/ rdo rje rnon po sngon g.yas ral gri g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/

rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing 'dzin pa/ rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi gdan bzhi la/ rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bsrung ba ser po rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar che ba 'dzin pa/ rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo bsnyen pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis ka 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du glu ma dkar dmar pi wang 'dzin pa/ byang shar du gar ma ljang ku phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar lhor bdug spos ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dri chab ma ljang khu dang dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo de nyid kyi shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang du rdo rje dril bu ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yog dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can padma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /thab kyi phyi rol gyi zlum bskor dang po'i phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi steng du/

shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi sku mdog sngon po/ lhor spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi ser po/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyongs/ dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi dmar po/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi ljang khu/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kha dang / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi zlum bskor gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi steng du/ shar du 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mau'u 'gal gyi bu/ lhor rab 'byor/ 'char dga'/ ma 'gags pa/ kau'u de n+ya ya/ nub tu nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag kun dga' bo/ byang du ming chen/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste nyan thos chen po bcu drug po thams cad kyang lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zlum bskor de nyid kyi mtshams bzhi dang / phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gnyis te/ gnas bcu gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du gdung ba sel ba dang snang ba brtsegs pa/ shar lhor 'jigs pa med pa/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul ba dang shes rab 'gyogs chen/ lho nub tu ri bo rgyal/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra gcan dang bse ru lta bu/ nub byang du dug chen 'joms/ byang du rdzu 'phrul ston dang seng ge sgra/ byang shar du yid myur rnams dbu'i gtsug tor phyed dang bcas shing / drang srong gi cha lugs can/

'khar bsil dang po ti 'dzin pa/ chos gos bsnams shing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zlum bskor de nyid kyi phyogs bzhi'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis rgyab rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re ste bcu drug gi steng du/ shar du khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang / de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lhor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub tu khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'ching / de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ /rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang du khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyi'i 'khor yug gi gdan rnams kyi steng du/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad/ dga' bo dang 'jog po la sogs pa'i klu chen brgyad/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' chen brgyad/ snar ma dang smin drug la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes po la sogs pa rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ mahā bhai ra la sogs pa'i 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gang ba bzang po dang nor bu bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams dang / lang ka mgrin bcu la sogs pa'i srin po'i tshogs rnams dang / lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma la sogs pa bud med kyi tshogs rnams dang / tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa rdo rje phra men ma'i tshogs rnams dang / wa ra hi la sogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang /

gzhan yang ri'i lha dang / shing gi lha dang / grong gi lha dang / 'byung ba bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs ldan zhing / so so'i g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ bhri ta sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ buddha a bh-i ṣiñtsa sogs phyag dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ de nas/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin brlabs nas bstod pa'i bar dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin nam/ 'dir ni cho ga zor yang ba'i phyir bsdus pa 'di mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣas bsang / rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas gzi brjid bskyed/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa nas/ shabta hūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta argham̐ pra titstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ shabta'i bar gong 'og 'dra ba la argham̐ gyi gnas su puṣpe sogs bcug pa'i sngags mchod dharmā ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pa dang / de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna mu ku tra pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa rin po che'i cod pan dang / de bzhin du mu ku tra'i gnas su/ kun ḍa lis rna rgyan/ darṣas mgul rgyan/ a wa ha ras do shal/ ke yu ras dbu rgyan/ pa ri ka ḍaṃ kas gdub bu/ pa kaṃ wa las sor gdub/ pā da bha ra naṃ gyis rkang rgyan/ tsha traṃ kas gdugs/ dhwa dzas rgyal mtshan/ pa daṃ kas 'phan/ pa ḍa da mas lda ldi/ tsa ma ras rnga yab/ bi tā naṃ gyis bla bre/ siṃ ha ā sa nas seng ge'i gdan/ sha ya sarbanas gzim chas/ pa ri maṇḍal dha n+yes pho brang zlum po/ a me ya tsa tur praḥsapho brang gru bzhi/ dri ku ṭa graṃs khang pa nyis brtsegs/ tsand+ra a sa nas zla gdan/ puṣpe me tog wi ni pi waṃ/ gandhe/ dri chab/ nai wi tye zhal zas/ wasatra zhes pas gos la sogs pa dbul lo/

/de nas/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā la trām̐/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nirti āḥ zhes dang / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra ha/ oṃ badzra dhuṣpe hūm̐/ badzra ratna ma nu ta raṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ badzra dharma gā ya naiḥ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra karma ka ro da bhā we/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥzhes lha mo brgyad kyis mchod la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya a brta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pu tsi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi ratna sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar la/ wasti ratna/ mahā ta ratna/ ha sti ratna/ tu raṅga a shwa ratna/ kharṣa ratna/ sogs brjod cing dbul zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa kā ma gu na pū dzī te hūm̐/ de bzhin du ru pa'i gnas su/ shabta dang / ghandhe/ ra sa/ parṣe/ rnams 'jug pas mchod cing / de rnams kyi phyag rgya so so dang bcas pa dang / de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyag chen lnga dang bcas pa/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyis/ /sems can bsam pa bskong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab padmo kha rgyas pa/ /khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po/ /shākya ri dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus par ni zhi mdzad pa/ /me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang / /rigs kyi yum bzhin skur bstan pa/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma ki /dkar po sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/

/rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /sgeg mo 'phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma mchod pa'i lha mo dang / /spos dang me tog mar me ma/ /dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sgo bzhi dbus na legs bzhugs pa'i/ /dad sogs ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /sgo bsrung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i/ /byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar bsil po ti phyag /bslab sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel don la brten gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ /'byung ba ldog la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan cing / /stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang / /phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing / /'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pas bstod la/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i mjug tu spel tshig gong 'jig rten gsum rgyal ltar brjod cing / sngags kyi lhag chad kha skong ba'i skabs 'dir/ nyi ma gsum la thun lngar byas pa'i/ nyi ma dang po gnyis la thun gnyis gnyis dang / gsum pa'i nyin snga thun te thun lngar mdzad pa'i/ cho ga re la rtsa rig gi rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad re 'bul dgos pas/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung la/ thob mar rdzas rnams grangs bcu gcig re phul rjes/ snod gcig tu lag pa g.yas pas mtheb srin gyis til gsog cing rtsa rig drug brgya song mtshams snod kyi til de phul/

de rjes yam shing sogs sngar ltar phul ba dang / rtsa rig gong ltar bgrangs pa sogs lan bcu'i bar du byas pas/ thun re la sngags stong phrag drug re 'gro zhing / de ltar thun lngar byas pas khri tsho gsum 'gro bas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'grub pa'o/ /'di ni bsnyen pa'i skabs rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum gyi bsnyen pa byas pa la yin gyi/ 'bum phrag drug pa ltar na bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bsreg rdzas 'bul mtshams sogs snga ma'i rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /yang kha cig skyed sngags la grangs bzung bar mdzad kyang / bsnyen pa'i grangs skyed sngags la ma bzung bas/ phyag len snga ma 'di gtsang bar mngon no/ /de nas sbyong rgyal la rang sngags kyi nyi shu rtsa gcig lha gzhan rnams la rang rang gi sngags kyi gsum gsum/ mgron thabs pa rnams la sde tshan re re bzhin nam/ thun mong du rtsa rigs gis lan gsum/ 'khor yug pa rnams la rtsa rig gis lan gsum phul/ bsdu na lha thams cad la thun mong du rtsa rig 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul la/ mthar mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra titstsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde༞ badzra puṣpe sogs dang / lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di ni/ /mchog tu༞ ci bde༞ badzra dhuṣpe༞ sogs dang / mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing / /phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /ci bde༞ badzra ā lo ke sogs dang / lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/

/rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyi/ /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /badzra gandhe sogs dang / kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /badzra nai witya sogs dang / bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston pa'i/ /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra shabta pū dza sogs rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas phyag chen lnga dril gsil dang bcas pas/ gong bzhin bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ slar yang 'jig rten gsum rgyal la gong ltar nyer gcig sogs phul la gsol ba gdab/ yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'byung po bgegs kyi rigs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad a karṣā ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug ste/ thab kyi phyogs gcig tu 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod la/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas phyogs skyong / oṃ sarba lo ka ka ra sa pa ri wa ra/ zhes gong ltar spel tshig sbyar bas 'byung po/ oṃ sarba bi gha nān sa pa ri wā ra bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas bgegs la sogs pa rnams la lan gsum dbul/ slar yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥpadma kā ma la ya satwam̐ gyi gdan dbul/ thab kyi phyogs gcig tu 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa grangs ci rigs pa'i mthar spel tshig phyogs skyong ltar brjod de bar chad zhi bar gsol ba btab/

slar yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad a karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug ste/ thab kyi nye 'khor du 'khod par gyur/ ces brjod la/ rtsa rig gis bsreg rdzas rnams ci rigs par byin la mthar/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad sdug bsngal las grol nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams me lha la grangs ci rigs phul la/ sngar ltar mchod bstod bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ gtor ma rnams chus sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas bsang / rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra dzwa la sogs kyis gzi byin bskyed/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul du byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ādya nud pan na twad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing / dang po phyogs skyong la dbul te/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu 'jig rten skyong bar bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ padma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan phul la/ oṃ ind+ra ya/

agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni re tya ye/ wa ru ṇa ya/ wa ya be/ ku be rā ye/ i shwa rā ya/ uddham̐ gra ha ma/ surya gra ha/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa ṭa/ a dhi pa ta ye/ a to pri thi wi bhyaḥ a su ra bhyaḥ na ga bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag de nas sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes su so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ gṛhne daṃ argham̐ swāhā/ pa dyaṃ swāhā/ puṣpaṃ swāhā/ dhā paṃ swāhā/ di paṃ swāhā/ gandhaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho 'dzin/ /nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ 'og gi klu de sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ ces pas bstod/

de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sngar gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ udga de spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na kham̐ gṛ hne daṃ ba lyā dam̐ swāhā/ zhes gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba ni/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang ma'i dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas 'phrin las bcol la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu las 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/

/de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ bsrung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad nye bar zhi ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ khu tshur bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog cing / oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra gatstsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa 'byung po rnams la dbul te/ sngar ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ dril bu bsil zhing / lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e hye his spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ya satwam̐ gyis gdan phul/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ argham̐ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ de wa/ na ga gan dharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣya/ a ma nu ṣya/ sa pā ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ lan gsum gyis phul/ dril bsil dang bcas/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang /

/shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu steng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu bsil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang / /rgyal po'i bskor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang gsum mdo dang ni mdo bzhi dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seṅge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung ba gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /'phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas 'phrin las bcol zhing sngar ltar chos kyi sbyin pa dang / dril gsil dang bcas/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi sogs sngar ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛhne daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ se gol phyir gtog cing / gatstsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /gsum pa gzhi bdag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra a kā ro sogs kyis bsngos nas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol zhes brjod/

bzhi pa rigs drug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa bdun brjod la/ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mdzes dam pa la༞ sku 'jam klas la༞ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la༞ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad sdug bsngal las grol nas myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces pas rigs drug la bsngos/ lnga pa yi dwags la/ byin rlabs nas/ sangs rgyas bzhi'i mtshan gyi bar sngar bzhin byas la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di yi dwags kyi 'gro ba thams cad la sbyin no/ /gnod pa med par tshim nas/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal las grol ba dang / myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ drug pa bgegs rnams la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang / khyad par du yang / bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces tshar gcig dang / ṭa ki hūm̐ dza/ zhes tshar gsum brjod pas bgegs rnams gtor ma len pa'i phyir du 'ong bar bsams la/

lag pa g.yon khu tshur snying khar bcangs/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ gung ka re gung ka re swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sarba bighnan/ gṛhne daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ pā dyaṃ swāhā/ nas/ gandhe swāhā'i bar gyis mchod la/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdun nas bskor zhing mthar mchod sbyin dang bcas pas se gol bya zhing / gong gi sngags gsum gyi rjes su/ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ zhes sogs btags la lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin pas tshim par bsam la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel ba sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras can 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /zhes bsngos la/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song / /zhes brjod cing /

oṃ sarba bighnan gatstsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor la/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing / na maḥs manta ka ya wāka tsitta badzra ṇam̐/ na mo badzra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣṭa ka ṭa bhe ra wa ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ri shu pa hastā ya/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spho ṭa ya bi spho ṭa ya/ sarba bighnan/ bi na ya ka nān/ ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ anta kā ra ya swāhā/ zhes pas mtshams bcad de/ de nas bdag bskyed ltar rang nyid la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sogs lngas sngags rgyas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bhri ta sogs gsung gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlab brtan par bsgom/ oṃ badzra sa twa kro dha sogs khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags rgya tshar gsum snying khar bcas pas bdag dang gnas la sogs pa'i bar chad bsrung / de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ gong bsreg rdzas phul grub pa'i rjes kyi/ mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs nas bstod pa'i bar bzhin byas la/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya ba lan gsum la sogs pa brjod pa'i rjes su/ thal mo sbyar zhing / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes byas gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de ni mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pa/ /ma 'byor ma rnyed ma 'tshal ba/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis rnams/ /de dag thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis cho ga lhag chad kha bskang zhing / nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/

/rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ces dang mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog la/ badzra muḥzhes pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ de nas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /zhes pas me lha dang / mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i/ /'byung po sa 'og gyur pa dang / /sa steng 'khod pa gang yin pa'ang / /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ zhes mtheb srin gyis se gol byas pas 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad so so'i gnas su gshegs me yal ba dang thal ba rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor bar bya'o/ /par bsam la/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha la sogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na/ 'di'i dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud 'chad pa'am/ rab gnas bya ba dang / sbyin sreg blug pa la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las la dbang ba yin no/ /de ltar khyab bdag rnam snang chen po yi/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /bsnyen pa las rung nyams su khas blang tshul dang / /sbyin sreg cho ga'i lag len rab gsal 'di/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang chos rje kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /thugs sras rgyal tshab bsod nams dbang po dang / /grags pa blo gros mched kyi zhabs bsten zhing / /rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa chen po yis/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis bu gcig ltar 'tsho ba'i/ /za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /lcags 'brug tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /bla chen kun dga' snying po yab sras kyi/

/byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus bzang bcu bzhi'i/ /bzhi thog bla brang yang rtser legs par sbyar/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan/ /rang gi mchod g.yog dge slong wa gind+ra/ /shrī bha drā 'khon dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ zhes byas dad 'dun gyis/ /brtson 'grus 'bad rtsol chen pos mgyogs par bgyis/ /legs byas 'dis mthus bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sgrib pa kun byang bas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don kun/ /'bad med 'grub cing phyi ma lhan cig tu/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du padmo las/ /brdzus te skye nas sa lam mthar phyin te/ /slar yang gang 'dul sprul ba du ma yis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal kun rig gi bsnyen pa bya tshul dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i lag len gsal bar bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
